title: Boundary contract tests: schema completeness, fallback correctness, settlement isolation
objective: Add a dedicated test file (test_p29_t6_boundary_contract.py) that validates the full AppraisalInput → AppraisalOutput → settlement pipeline as an integrated boundary contract, going beyond what the individual P29-T1 through P29-T5 tests already verify in isolation.
exact_scope: One new test file covering four contract areas: (1) all 8 tick types can produce a valid AppraisalInput; (2) AppraisalOutput.from_deterministic_fallback produces a valid, fallback-flagged output for every tick type, with the correct absorption value per tick; (3) settlement receives only contract-bearing fields and is fully unaware of tick_type; (4) an end-to-end pipeline test that builds an AppraisalInput for each active tick (T1, T2, T4), calls from_deterministic_fallback, then calls settle_appraisal_output, and asserts the pipeline completes without error and produces a SettlementResult. No changes to any domain model, engine, or existing test file.
constraints: AppraisalSignal v1 must not be modified — it is frozen.
No bridge wiring may be added for deferred ticks (T3, T5, T6, T7, T8) — schema accommodation only.
Settlement functions must remain pure functions with no side effects.
from_deterministic_fallback must not be called with arguments beyond an AppraisalInput instance.

The new test file must not duplicate assertions already present in test_appraisal_input_schema.py, test_appraisal_output_schema.py, test_p29_t3_deferred_fallback.py, test_p29_t4_bridge_boundary.py, or test_p29_t5_settlement_boundary.py.
No LLM runtime code may be introduced.
T4 old deterministic path must not be reactivated through gate manipulation.
acceptance_criteria: A file back/tests/test_p29_t6_boundary_contract.py exists and all tests in it pass with pytest.
All 8 tick types (T1–T8) have at least one test asserting that a valid AppraisalInput can be constructed for that tick type.
All 8 tick types have at least one test asserting that from_deterministic_fallback returns a valid AppraisalOutput with fallback_used=True and confidence=1.0.
Deferred ticks (T3, T5, T6, T7, T8) each assert absorption=none in their fallback output.
T1 and T2 fallback outputs assert absorption=surface.
T4 fallback with no social_event_context asserts absorption=none; T4 fallback with social_event_context present asserts absorption=surface.

At least one test verifies that settle_appraisal_output does not inspect the tick_type advisory field: two AppraisalOutput instances that differ only in tick_type must produce identical SettlementResult values.

At least one end-to-end pipeline test per active tick (T1, T2, T4) builds an AppraisalInput, calls from_deterministic_fallback to obtain an AppraisalOutput, calls settle_appraisal_output, and asserts the result is a SettlementResult with no exception raised.
The full test suite (all existing tests plus the new file) continues to pass without modification to any other file.
The new test file has no more than 30 test functions total.
required_tests: For each of the 8 tick types: building an AppraisalInput with the correct required context slices succeeds and the resulting object has tick_type matching that tick.
For each of the 8 tick types: calling AppraisalOutput.from_deterministic_fallback with a valid AppraisalInput returns an AppraisalOutput where fallback_used is True and confidence is 1.0.
For deferred ticks T3, T5, T6, T7, T8: the fallback output has absorption equal to none, growth is an empty list, and aftershock_days is 0.
For T1 and T2: the fallback output has absorption equal to surface.
For T4 without social_event_context: fallback output has absorption equal to none.
For T4 with social_event_context present: fallback output has absorption equal to surface.

Two AppraisalOutput instances that are identical on all contract-bearing fields but differ on tick_type (advisory) produce identical numeric results from settle_appraisal_output — same mood score, stress, growth buffer, and residual shape.
Two AppraisalOutput instances that are identical on all contract-bearing fields but differ on narrative_summary and fallback_used produce identical numeric results from settle_appraisal_output.
End-to-end pipeline for T1: AppraisalInput constructed, from_deterministic_fallback called, settle_appraisal_output called, result is a SettlementResult — no exception raised.
End-to-end pipeline for T2: same pipeline as T1, with a relational_context slice included in the input.
End-to-end pipeline for T4 with no social_event_context: pipeline completes, SettlementResult.residual is None (absorption=none means no residual).
DEFERRED_FALLBACK_DISPATCH covers exactly the five deferred EventCategory values and no others.
non_goals: Do not wire any deferred tick (T3, T5, T6, T7, T8) to the bridge or settlement path.

Do not test or modify the existing four individual settlement functions (apply_appraisal_to_state, accumulate_growth_from_appraisal, apply_appraisal_to_relationship, create_residual_from_appraisal) directly — those are covered by test_p29_t5_settlement_boundary.py.
Do not test tick_bridge builder functions (build_signal_from_t1_world_tick etc.) — those are covered by test_p29_t4_bridge_boundary.py.
Do not add integration tests that run the full day_simulator 8-tick loop.
Do not add performance or load tests.
Do not introduce any new domain model fields or enums.
Do not modify vision.md or road_map.md.
